[[Captain/Legends|Captain]] '''Piedell''' was a [[Gender/Legends|man]] who served the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] as an officer during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
Piedell held the rank of [[Captain/Legends|captain]] and served as the administrative assistant to [[Zerex]], the [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] of the [[Meridian sector/Legends|Meridian sector]]. When Zerex held a party in his mansion on the frozen [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ord Adinorr]] to celebrate his promotion to moff, Piedell attended. During the celebration, Piedell commanded a detachment of ten [[Cold weather assault trooper|snowtroopers]], whom he ordered to patrol outside the mansion and guard sensitive locations within it.<ref name="Scum and Villainy" />
